name: notifications
description: The User Notifications API Reference provides descriptions, API request parameters, and the JSON response for each of the User Notifications API actions.

subcommands.name: associate-channel
subcommands.description: Associates a delivery Channel with a particular NotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: associate-managed-notification-account-contact
subcommands.description: Associates an Account Contact with a particular ManagedNotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: associate-managed-notification-additional-channel
subcommands.description: Associates an additional Channel with a particular ManagedNotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: associate-organizational-unit
subcommands.description: Associates an organizational unit with a notification configuration.

subcommands.name: create-event-rule
subcommands.description: Creates an EventRule that is associated with a specified NotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: create-notification-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a new NotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: delete-event-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes an EventRule.

subcommands.name: delete-notification-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a NotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: deregister-notification-hub
subcommands.description: Deregisters a NotificationConfiguration in the specified Region.

subcommands.name: disable-notifications-access-for-organization
subcommands.description: Disables service trust between User Notifications and Amazon Web Services Organizations.

subcommands.name: disassociate-channel
subcommands.description: Disassociates a Channel from a specified NotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: disassociate-managed-notification-account-contact
subcommands.description: Disassociates an Account Contact with a particular ManagedNotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: disassociate-managed-notification-additional-channel
subcommands.description: Disassociates an additional Channel from a particular ManagedNotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: disassociate-organizational-unit
subcommands.description: Removes the association between an organizational unit and a notification configuration.

subcommands.name: enable-notifications-access-for-organization
subcommands.description: Enables service trust between User Notifications and Amazon Web Services Organizations.

subcommands.name: get-event-rule
subcommands.description: Returns a specified EventRule.

subcommands.name: get-managed-notification-child-event
subcommands.description: Returns the child event of a specific given ManagedNotificationEvent.

subcommands.name: get-managed-notification-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns a specified ManagedNotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: get-managed-notification-event
subcommands.description: Returns a specified ManagedNotificationEvent.

subcommands.name: get-notification-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns a specified NotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: get-notification-event
subcommands.description: Returns a specified NotificationEvent.

subcommands.name: get-notifications-access-for-organization
subcommands.description: Returns the AccessStatus of Service Trust Enablement for User Notifications and Amazon Web Services Organizations.

subcommands.name: list-channels
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Channels for a NotificationConfiguration.

subcommands.name: list-event-rules
subcommands.description: Returns a list of EventRules according to specified filters, in reverse chronological order (newest first).

subcommands.name: list-managed-notification-channel-associations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Account contacts and Channels associated with a ManagedNotificationConfiguration, in paginated format.

subcommands.name: list-managed-notification-child-events
subcommands.description: Returns a list of ManagedNotificationChildEvents for a specified aggregate ManagedNotificationEvent, ordered by creation time in reverse chronological order (newest first).

subcommands.name: list-managed-notification-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Managed Notification Configurations according to specified filters, ordered by creation time in reverse chronological order (newest first).

subcommands.name: list-managed-notification-events
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Managed Notification Events according to specified filters, ordered by creation time in reverse chronological order (newest first).

subcommands.name: list-member-accounts
subcommands.description: Returns a list of member accounts associated with a notification configuration.

subcommands.name: list-notification-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of abbreviated NotificationConfigurations according to specified filters, in reverse chronological order (newest first).

subcommands.name: list-notification-events
subcommands.description: Returns a list of NotificationEvents according to specified filters, in reverse chronological order (newest first).

subcommands.name: list-notification-hubs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of NotificationHubs.

subcommands.name: list-organizational-units
subcommands.description: Returns a list of organizational units associated with a notification configuration.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags for a specified Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: register-notification-hub
subcommands.description: Registers a NotificationConfiguration in the specified Region.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tags the resource with a tag key and value.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Untags a resource with a specified Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: update-event-rule
subcommands.description: Updates an existing EventRule.

subcommands.name: update-notification-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates a NotificationConfiguration.
